title: flui challenge
description: One authored training/diagnosis challenge of the flui catalog. The authoritative implementation of these rules is content/lib/src/validation/challenge_validators.dart; this document exists so editors and agents can see the shape. Content strings are Spanish.

id.description: Database identity. Derived deterministically from the slug by content:emit.

sort_order.description: Emission order. Never authored: assigned by content:emit's deterministic ordering (purpose, diagnosis_slot, mode, difficulty, slug).

status.description: Same authoring gate as words: only approved is emitted.

diagnosis_slot.description: Required iff purpose = diagnosis; null otherwise.

mode.description: Required iff purpose = training; null otherwise.

focus_behaviors.description: Wire codes from content/lib/src/model/behavior_catalog.dart, matching the challenge's skill.
